overall_health.description:
'healthy' when no SDKs need updating, 'needs_attention' otherwise.

* `healthy` - healthy
* `needs_attention` - needs_attention

health.description:
UI-level status — 'success' when healthy, 'warning' when some SDKs are outdated, 'danger' when the majority are outdated.

* `success` - success
* `warning` - warning
* `danger` - danger

needs_updating_count.description: Number of SDKs that need updating.

team_sdk_count.description: Number of distinct PostHog SDKs the project is actively using.
